fields.label: Description
fields.before:
[Master Level: 20]
Rushes forward a certain distance in the direction you are facing. If there are monsters within the rush range, you can deal damage to up to 4 of them and knock them back a certain distance. While rushing, you will not be knocked back even if attacked by monsters.
